title: Casa Serenity
description:
Casa Serenity offers an atmosphere of relaxation and tranquility to its guests.  Ideal for family gatherings.
Located on a 5.2-acre property surrounded by abundant vegetation and wildlife (deer, coyotes, among others.) Its interior will make you experience serenity and connection with nature. 
Casa Serenity is located north of Wilson County in the city of Mt. Juliet, 3.3 miles from Cedar Creek Campground and the Marina, 35 minutes from the Airport, and 45 minutes from Downtown Nashville.

The space
The house has 4 bedrooms. 6 beds
Master bedroom: king size bed / Bedroom 2: queen size bed / Bedroom 3: queen size bed / Bedroom 4: queen size bed / Common area 2 queen size beds.

Guest access
Ample parking for up to 8 vehicles. Access to the entire house except for storage areas.

Other things to note
Outdoor living: roofed deck, charcoal grill, patio chairs, fire pit.
